messages:
alex: Luisa Hernandez is remote and starts Mon. BG flagged an SSN/alias mismatch (Hernandez vs Martinez). She requests a Spanish interpreter for day-1 benefits session and needs an authorized-agent notary for I-9. Can People Ops coordinate authorized representative + interpreter? cc: @it-support @legal.ops

peopleops: We can coordinate an authorized representative + notarized copies. Remote I-9 via an authorized agent is allowed, but we need the agent attestation form completed and scanned documents uploaded to Workday. Sending agent-form link and expense guidance.

bg-checks-bot: Background check update for Luisa Hernandez (Order #BG-88102): "SSN/alias mismatch" 0 vendor requests SSA card or court documentation. Upload portal: https://bg.vendor/portal/DEF456 (expires 72h).

candidate-luisa: Hola 0 thanks. I can get a certified notary to copy and notarize my SSA card and passport, but those are in my parents' home. Ill schedule a notary Tue morning. I only speak Spanish 0 can interpreter join the notary or just benefits call? Also can I get reimbursed for notary fees?

legal.ops: Notary and certified copy accepted for verification. Reimbursement allowed under onboarding policy (submit receipt via Expense). For the authorized agent we need: agent name, company, contact, and a signed attestation form (we provide template). Ensure notarized docs are uploaded to the candidate portal; vendor acceptance is case-by-case but usually OK.

peopleops: Plan: 1) Send agent attestation PDF & instructions to Luisa. 2) Candidate schedules local notary and uploads notarized scans to BG portal. 3) People Ops signs attestation, files into Workday, and notes remote I-9 method. 4) Book remote Spanish interpreter (vendor) for benefits + join notary call if vendor confirms. 5) IT to prep laptop and expedite shipping.

it-support: Provisioning started for luisa.hernandez@redwood.com. Standard ship ETA 3 business days; we can bump to next-day if People Ops approves express shipping cost.

candidate-luisa: Please do express shipping 0 Ill upload notarized docs asap. Interpreter joining notary would help me feel comfortable.

peopleops: Got it. Booking interpreter and adding note to expense. Agent-form link: https://redwood.company/onboard/agent-attestation.pdf. Expense submit: https://expense.redwood/submit. Please upload receipts and the notarized scans to the BG portal once complete.

bg-checks-bot: Vendor portal received new upload from candidate (notarized SSA copy). Verification in progress 0 ETA ~6h.

legal.ops: Flagging for manual review if vendor returns any discrepancies. We'll hold offer contingent items until cleared.

alex: Thanks everyone. Luisa 0 welcome! We'll confirm interpreter slot and ship laptop express once receipt is filed. :raised_hands:
